metadata.title: Magnificent Seven ETF drops sharply as Tesla, Nvidia see biggest losses in the fund - MarketWatch

content.text:
10 hours ago
Magnificent Seven ETF drops sharply as Tesla, Nvidia see biggest losses in the fund
Big Tech stocks were largely struggling Friday, with an exchange-traded that holds the so-called Magnificent Seven reflecting their selloff.
The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF was down 2.3%, as six of the seven closely watched Big Tech stocks in its portfolio fell. Tesla shares had the biggest drop, sliding 5.5%, while Nvidia’s 5% slump left the chip maker with the next-largest decline among the ETF’s holdings.
The fund also holds shares of Google parent Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon.com, Apple and Facebook parent Meta Platforms. Among the Magnificent Seven, Apple was the sole Big Tech stock in positive territory, with a modest 0.2% gain, FactSet data showed at last check.
